reserveReview.rationale: 2026-07-31 re-open: cNGN's transparency page states that tokens are maintained 1:1 with Naira in licensed custodian banks and that reserve funds receive monthly audits. WrappedCBDC's terms limit minting to Naira deposits and require each token to be backed 1:1 by Naira held in reserve; the ASC FAQ independently describes partner commercial-bank reserve accounts and traditional-currency/cash-equivalent backing. No dated reserve-attestation artifact or custodian-bank names were retrievable, so the current structured envelope remains 100% Naira bank deposits and does not preserve the earlier unsupported 54%/46% split.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The page does not identify the custodian banks, their allocation shares, account terms, or link a dated reserve examination report; the exact deposit liquidity is therefore unknown.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The 2026-07-31 re-opened issuer transparency, terms, and ASC FAQ identify only licensed/partner commercial banks and reserve accounts; they do not name active banks, disclose allocation shares, establish segregation or bankruptcy remoteness, state anti-rehypothecation terms, or document failure/replacement/successor-custody mechanics.
